title: Felt diorama town
prompt_en: Stop-motion felt and paper diorama, 16:9. A tiny felt bus drives through a paper town, wobbling slightly, cotton clouds above. Tilt-shift look, warm craft textures, handmade charm.
prompt_zh: 毛毡与纸艺定格微缩场景，16:9。一辆小小的毛毡巴士驶过纸做的小镇，轻微晃动，上方是棉花云。移轴效果，温暖手工质感，手作魅力。
why_it_works: Material words (felt, paper, cotton) plus tilt-shift strongly cue the miniature look.
